decisive_items: Small red node and mild joint deformity at distal interphalangeal joint of left index finger
Hebreden node at DIP of the left index finger
response.rationale: The presence of a Hebreden node and joint deformity at the DIP joint is more specific for Psoriatic Arthritis than the general symptoms of arthritis that could be related to SARS-CoV-2 infection

rejected.why: Negative Rheumatoid factor and normal anti-CCP antibodies contradict this diagnosis
